_doc: Reactions (autoload/chemistry_engine.gd), docs/DATA_SCHEMA.md. Abstracted on purpose (CLAUDE.md §6): no amounts, temperatures or step-by-step methods. zone: where it happens (workbench = the study's alchemist workbench; rusty_lock = the dressing-room gate). duration.modes: real seconds per difficulty (0 = instant); speedup: a faster variant when the given item is used. on_finish_flags: GameManager flags set when a process ends. codex: the Codex entry it unlocks (data/codex.json).

science_note.en: Oranges are full of citric acid - that's what makes them sour.
Salt crystals are a mild abrasive: they help scrub loosened rust away.

duration.real_note: hours to a day for a real rusty lock

science_note.en: Citric acid slowly dissolves rust - that's how many store-bought rust removers work. Salt is a mild abrasive that helps scrub it off.
